en.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
en.title: Let His peace rule your heart

es.text: Y la paz de Dios gobierne en vuestros corazones, a la que asimismo fuisteis llamados en un solo cuerpo; y sed agradecidos.
es.title: Que su paz gobierne tu corazón
